description: Compute US federal self-employment tax (Social Security and Medicare, Schedule SE) on a year's net self-employment profit, plus the income tax on that profit and a per-quarter amount. Use it for freelancers, sole proprietors, 1099 contractors and single-member LLC owners. Handles W-2 wages in the same year and the Additional Medicare Tax. Returns exact figures from Ted's tax calculator, the official IRS sources behind them, and the tax year used. Federal only; no state tax.

filing_status.description: Filing status: single, mfj (married filing jointly), mfs (married filing separately) or hoh (head of household). Default single.

net_profit.description: Net self-employment profit for the year (Schedule C net profit, after business expenses), in US dollars (whole dollars, no symbols)

tax_year.description: The tax year the figures are for (2025, 2026, 2027). Leave it out for the default: last year's return until April 15, then the current year.

w2_wages.description: W-2 wages from a job in the same year, if any (they use up the Social Security wage cap first), in US dollars (whole dollars, no symbols)

name: estimate_self_employment_tax
title: Estimate self-employment tax
